verdict.rationale: Rippling shows scattered AI-driven natural-language touchpoints—an 'AI to build reports and dashboards' feature and a dashboard prompt example ('Show me headcount vs plan'), plus an AI Q&A assistant for benefits questions—but these are narrow, feature-specific and not a general natural-language interface for operating the whole platform (e.g., running payroll, managing HR/IT tasks via chat commands). Missing for 10: evidence of a unified conversational/agentic interface that can execute cross-module actions (payroll runs, HR changes, integrations) via natural language, and any independent/hands-on confirmation of these AI features working as described.
